notes.title: Comic Book Store Simulator Demo Update
notes.content:
Today, we bring you a small fix and balancing for the demo. Thank you for the support and feedback!

All item prices have been balanced.,

Profit margins have been adjusted.,

The maximum number of customers has been increased.,

New customer models have been added.,

Plenty of bug fixes
